company.name: Sabbar
company.shortDescription: Sabbar is a niche on-demand staffing platform for gig workers in the retail, hospitality, and entertainment industries in MENA.
company.description:
Sabbar is an on-demand staffing platform that specializes in blue-collar jobs in the retail, hospitality, and entertainment industry in MENA. Our platform enables businesses to hire casual staff during peak hours or high seasons by connecting them to highly qualified and fully vetted professionals. Additionally, we relieve our customers from associated administrative costs by streamlining a lengthy process that typically includes interviews, training, placement, shift scheduling, worker payments, and everything in-between.

To learn more, visit: sabbar.com

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,614,305 to $39,557,942, a 15.13x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 57 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
